title: CapabilitiesDocument
description: The capabilities document an implementation publishes at its canonical origin (ADR-068 §13 endpoint map). It declares the protocol surfaces the implementation implements. It is descriptive, not a permission or a grant — a certification's scope is never wider than the evidence. Documentary/reference contract; introduces no new financial invariant.
_authority: ADR-068 (§4.4 origin of inputs), ADR-067 (Operador Zero read-only reference)
_boundary: Declaring a capability confers no permission and moves no funds.

capabilities.description: Named capability flags the implementation declares (e.g. supports_wallets, supports_qr).

capability_list.description: Flat list of declared capability identifiers.
